title: AI Service QoS — request-level field evidence, Case Study 1 (Qwen3.8-Max / Qoder CN)
description: This is the archived snapshot of the request-level evidence behind AI Service QoS — Independent Measurement of What Users Actually Receive (methodology v0.1): one submitted user request per row, its outcome class, its latency on two clocks, the provider's own error strings kept verbatim, and the anonymised client log lines each figure was derived from. Two collection rounds, kept separate and labelled: 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-09 (20 conversations, 33 timeout events) and 2026-09-10 (62 request episodes from 55 submitted prompts, with per-request context occupancy). The work is a client-side measurement of the service quality an artificial-intelligence service delivers under real user workloads; it does not benchmark the model and does not audit the provider. Every published figure is re-derivable: the bundle ships scripts/analyze.py, which asserts each number, scripts/verify_dataset_card.py, which asserts the card against the files, and scripts/check_release_sync.py, which compares this archived snapshot byte for byte with the Hugging Face dataset repository and the source repository. Text and data are Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; the executable tooling in the source repository is MIT — Zenodo holds one licence field, so it declares the licence of what is archived here.
notes: Author: an independent, unaffiliated individual — the empty affiliation field is deliberate.
